changes: Replaced the 288 individually molded tan seat blocks with 24 continuous satin-aluminum bleacher bench tiers, split around the existing 3.4 m center aisle. Each row has a dark nosing edge. The photograph supports metal bleacher banks and center aisle; all dimensions and exact tier/circulation layout are estimates.

Replaced barely visible short fixtures with 18 long linear luminous diffusers and matching balanced area lights. Their elongated appearance is based on the Arsee project photo; the Huston Electric page confirms a building-specific LED installation. The modeled count, spacing, output and aiming remain estimated.

Replaced floating overhead display panels with six separate wall-mounted black banner panels and wall standoffs, spelling PURDUE in large gold letters. Panel locations follow the modeled pier bays. The motif is photo-supported, but exact panel dimensions and locations are estimates.

Changed the existing blue ribbon-glazing finish to a darker, lower-roughness blue-gray and added head and jamb reveals to the north-facing panes. The north Street View supports brick, ribbon glazing and entry language; reveal dimensions are a visual refinement, not measured elevation data.
Kept the roof/trusses and optional site dressing separate from the revised facade/interior presentation; no roof geometry or site-placement claim was added.

Added 24 continuous graphite riser plates beneath the existing 24 representative aluminum bench sections to make the two tier banks read as connected bleachers. Their dimensions and structural function are illustrative, not an as-built seating plan.

Added 24 square handrail posts, one aligned to each of 12 aisle treads on both sides, and modestly thickened the two existing sloped rails. The posts visually meet the stair treads and existing handrails; exact rail dimensions and accessibility compliance remain unverified.

Added a saved interior cutaway presentation camera. The R9 render script temporarily hides the full roof surface, standing seams, ridge cap, and one eave fascia for the cutaway images; those objects are restored for render setup and the saved source retains the complete roof. Existing 21 schematic truss meshes remain in the asset and are exposed above the pool and seating in the review view.

Coordinator reported a read-only check of the master marker: (-808.6829834, 80.3369980, 0) translation, unit scale and zero rotation. It agrees with manifest origin (-808.683, 80.337) within 0.000017 m. This report is recorded as coordinator-provided evidence; this revision did not open or save the master.
